overview_description.description: Melotic, Inc. is a cryptocurrency technology company founded in 2014 based in Hong Kong. Our team includes experienced technologists and professionals, and all of us love bitcoin and its potential. We believe that bitcoin and cryptocurrencies have the potential to make big changes to our world, and we are excited to be a part of it.
